svg.title: How the Army is built
svg.desc: Corps, Division, Brigade and Battalion: what each level owns (solid) and what it lends or receives (dashed).

text.tspan: How the Army is built: what each level owns and what it lends
Every level OWNS some units (solid) and LENDS some down (dashed).
Below Brigade, nothing is a self-contained mix of arms until other arms are allotted to it.
zoom: the next band opens this box
Inside Alpha Coy: Coy HQ + 3 platoons
Strengths and names are indicative; actual organisation varies by role and terrain.
